text:
maria: Idea: one waterfall visual that stacks p50/p95/p99 latency per model config and overlays $/1k tokens. hero for webinar + compact blog image.

alex: Yes. Show hosted vs dedicated columns and a tiny $$ conversion table (e.g., 1M, 10M tokens). makes it tangible.

sam: Data ask to runtime: CSV with model,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,cache_on,deploy_type. benchbot: attached run 6141 summary link.

benchbot: run=6141, models=[redwood-small,redwood-med,open-xl], fields included.

jordan: Add dashed fallback line to illustrate routing to cheaper variant under heavy tail. supports graceful degradation messaging.
liv: Copy options (short): "Shrink the tail, save on tokens" or "Latency and dollars: practical benchmarks". Which for paid?
alex: First for paid; punchier. second for blog.
maria: Deliverables: (1) Hero waterfall slide (png + editable) (2) social static + 3 copy variants (3) landing blurb + signup routing. Routing: if product_interest=Dedicated OR (company_size>=200 AND product_interest!=Hosted) -> SDR, else nurture.
sam: I'll deliver CSV + Figma frame by Tuesday; PNG draft by Tuesday EOD.
liv: I'll write social copy + 3 email subjects by Wed AM and drop in #content-review.
jordan: Add compliance footnote: "Benchmarks run in a controlled environment; results may vary by workload." small gray text.
maria: Great. Keep annotations focused: callouts for caching impact and routing fallback. :rocket:
